notes:
Based on the match, you defected on the last round, and they still cooperated. This eliminates Tit-for-Tat (which would have defected in round 8), Grim Trigger (which would have defected permanently after your defection), and Tit-for-Two-Tats (which would have defected after two defections). Pavlov would have defected after a mutual cooperation, but they didn't, so it's likely Always Cooperate or Random.

Against Always Cooperate, you should defect every round to maximize your score. However, since Random is still possible, I recommend defecting again next round; if they cooperate, you can be nearly certain they are Always Cooperate and continue defecting. If they defect, you'll know they are Random and can adjust accordingly.
